newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Superconductor to offer 1 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Superconductor to offer 1 mln shrs.

text.p: Illinois Superconductor Corp filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of up to one million common shares.
Underwriters have been granted a 30-day over-allotment option on 150,000 additional shares.
The offering will be made through Gruntal & Co Inc.

Net proceeds will be used for product development, expansion of sales and marketing efforts, working captial, acquisition of manufacturing equipment, and general corporate purposes, the Mt. Prospect, Ill.-based company said.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 6,023,352.

Illinois Superconductor develops, manufactures and markets high-performance products for wireless telecommunication markets based on proprietary high-temperature superconductor materials, radio frequency, filter design and cryogenic technologies.
